title: Motion on AI-enabled growth and support for workers and enterprises
what_it_is: A Motion moved by Mr Ng Chee Meng setting out four commitments on AI-enabled economic growth, fairness, worker and enterprise support, and inclusive progress, followed by debate and a ministerial response.
why_it_matters: The transcript sets out measures that affect workers and businesses: from the second half of this year, Singaporeans enrolled in selected SkillsFuture AI courses will receive six months of free access to premium AI tools; eligible businesses will receive $10,000 under the redesigned SkillsFuture Enterprise Credit later this year; and all IHLs will offer selected AI-related courses for alumni at a significant discount for a year starting in the second half of this year. It also records that the Government will study improvements to the SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support scheme and that tripartite partners are discussing shortening retrenchment notification under the Employment Act review.

key_points.point: Mr Ng Chee Meng moved a Motion recognising AI's transformative power and setting out commitments on fairness, resilience, opportunity, worker and enterprise support, and inclusive growth.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: That this House (1) recognises the transformative power of new technologies, especially Artificial Intelligence (AI), to drive Singapore's next phase of economic development

key_points.point: He declared his interest as NTUC Secretary-General.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: I declare my interest as the Secretary-General of the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC)

key_points.point: He outlined a first practical move: build market intelligence and foresight for an AI-enabled economy.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: First, we must build market intelligence and foresight for an AI-enabled economy.

key_points.point: He outlined a second move: enable enterprises to transform with AI in a way that benefits workers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: Second, we must enable enterprises to transform with AI and do so in a way that benefits workers.

key_points.point: He outlined a third move: enable workers to seize new opportunities.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: Third, enabling workers to seize new opportunities.

key_points.point: He outlined a fourth move: enable displaced workers to bounce back with dignity and confidence.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: Fourth, we must enable displaced workers to bounce back with dignity and confidence.

key_points.point: He proposed expanding Company Training Committees together with SNEF under the new Tripartite Jobs Council.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: I propose that we do so together with the Singapore National Employers Federation (SNEF) as part of the new Tripartite Jobs Council.

key_points.point: He said NTUC LearningHub intends to scale AI-Ready SG to more than one million training places over the next few years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: NTUC LearningHub intends to scale these efforts under AI-Ready SG to more than one million training places over the next few years.

key_points.point: He said the Union Training Assistance Programme will be expanded to offset subscriptions to selected AI tools.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: The Union Training Assistance Programme will be expanded to help offset the cost of subscriptions to selected AI tools.

key_points.point: He said advance notification of retrenchments is being studied in the ongoing review of the Employment Act.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: I am glad that this is being studied in the ongoing review of the Employment Act.

key_points.point: He said the Labour Movement proposes to expand the coverage of the SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support scheme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: The Labour Movement now proposes to expand the coverage of the scheme.

key_points.point: He said the focus should shift from managing retrenchment to enabling firms to redesign jobs and retrain workers alongside transformation.
key_points.speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
key_points.quote: We should shift the focus from managing retrenchment to enabling all firms to redesign jobs and retrain workers so that they transform and the workforce adjustment happens alongside transformation, not after it.

key_points.point: He proposed moving more deliberately towards a "place and train" model.
key_points.speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
key_points.quote: We should, therefore, move more deliberately towards a "place and train" model.

key_points.point: He declared that he works in a bank in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: I would like to declare that I am working in a bank, a financial institution in Singapore.

key_points.point: He said he had proposed a National Master Trades Accreditation framework to recognise progression, reward deep skills and integrate AI competencies.
key_points.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: This is why I have also proposed a National Master Trades Accreditation framework during the last Committee of Supply, to recognise progression, reward deep skills and integrate AI competencies.

key_points.point: He noted that Budget 2026 announced a National AI Council led by Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.
key_points.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: Budget 2026 announced the establishment of a National AI Council led by Prime Minister Lawrence Wong

key_points.point: He said MENDAKI and NTUC's e2i jointly piloted Langkah Digital AI workshops in community settings, with plans to scale further this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
key_points.quote: MENDAKI and NTUC's e2i jointly piloted Langkah Digital AI workshops in community settings, with plans to scale further this year

key_points.point: She called on the Government to fund systematic study and mapping of actual job roles and workflows for job redesign.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: I call on the Government to resource this properly: to fund systematic study and mapping of actual job roles and workflows, so that job redesign is built on ground truths and not just assumptions.

key_points.point: She said AI grants must be tied to mandatory job redesign requirements and productivity gains linked to worker outcomes.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: AI grants must be tied to mandatory job redesign requirements and productivity gains linked to worker outcomes.

key_points.point: She said companies unable to retain workers should be required to notify the Government early.
key_points.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
key_points.quote: If these enterprises are unable to retain our workers, these companies should be required to notify the Government early on personnel whom they are unable to retain

key_points.point: He proposed establishing a National AI Equity Fund.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I propose the establishment of a National AI Equity Fund.

key_points.point: He proposed an initial citizen dividend of $500 per adult citizen, scaling upward as fund contributions grow.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I propose an initial citizen dividend of $500 per adult citizen, scaling upward as fund contributions grow.

key_points.point: He proposed a mastery fund providing a mastery apprentice wage covering 50% of gross salary, capped at median wage for six months, for Singapore citizens entering or transitioning into AI-augmented roles.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I propose that the mastery fund provides a mastery apprentice wage covering 50% of the gross salary, capped at a median wage for six months, for any Singapore citizen entering or transitioning into an AI-augmented role.

key_points.point: He proposed financing the fund partly through a two-percentage-point corporate income tax increase for firms with annual profits exceeding $100 million.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: The first source is a marginal increase of two percentage points of the corporate income tax rate for firms with annual profits exceeding $100 million.

key_points.point: He also proposed raising the maximum net investment returns taken into the Budget from 50% to 52.5%, with the additional 2.5% flowing into the fund.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
key_points.quote: I propose raising the maximum net investment returns taken into the Budget from 50% to 52.5%, with this additional 2.5% flowing directly into the fund.

key_points.point: He said the Government formed its first National AI Strategy in 2019, before ChatGPT.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We formed our first National AI Strategy in 2019, well before the introduction of ChatGPT

key_points.point: He said the Government formed the National AI Council chaired by the Prime Minister to drive practical AI transformation.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: we formed the National AI Council chaired by our Prime Minister to drive the practical transformation of our economy using AI.

key_points.point: He said MOM's inaugural survey of firms shows AI is currently augmenting rather than replacing labour in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Our inaugural survey of the firms shows that AI is currently augmenting, rather than replacing labour in Singapore.

key_points.point: He said about three in 10 firms have adopted AI, and among adopters only about 6% reported reduced headcount.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Only about three in 10 firms have adopted AI currently, and amongst the firms that have adopted AI, only a small minority, about 6%, reported reduced headcount.

key_points.point: He said seven in 10 firms using AI are already seeing productivity gains.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: And seven in 10 firms using AI are already seeing productivity gains.

key_points.point: He said the formation of SWDA will bring SkillsFuture Singapore and Workforce Singapore under one roof.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: this formation of SWDA will bring the skills and employment facilitation capabilities of SkillsFuture Singapore and Workforce Singapore under one roof

key_points.point: He said from the second half of this year, Singaporeans enrolled in selected SkillsFuture AI courses will receive six months of free access to premium AI tools.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: From the second half of this year, Singaporeans who enrol in the selected SkillsFuture AI courses will receive six months of free access to premium AI tools.

key_points.point: He said over $400 million has been set aside for the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: we have set aside over $400 million for the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Package.

key_points.point: He said eligible businesses will receive $10,000 under the redesigned SkillsFuture Enterprise Credit later this year.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Later this year, eligible businesses will also receive $10,000 under the redesigned SkillsFuture Enterprise Credit

key_points.point: He said the Government topped up the NTUC CTC Grant by around $200 million in 2025 and extended it to 2028.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The Government topped up the NTUC CTC Grant by around $200 million in 2025 and extended the grant to 2028.

key_points.point: He said the SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support scheme provides temporary financial relief and job search support to involuntarily unemployed individuals.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The JSS provides temporary financial relief and job search support to involuntarily unemployed individuals.

key_points.point: He said the Government will look at how the scheme can be improved and will study this carefully.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We will look at how the scheme can be improved and we will study this carefully.

key_points.point: He said tripartite partners are discussing shortening the retrenchment notification duration under the Employment Act review.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Tripartite partners are already discussing shortening the retrenchment notification duration under the ongoing Employment Act review.

key_points.point: He said the Government supported NTUC's proposal to form the Tripartite Jobs Council.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: And this is why we supported wholeheartedly NTUC's proposal to form the Tripartite Jobs Council.

key_points.point: He said all IHLs will offer selected AI-related courses for alumni at a significant discount for a year, starting in the second half of this year.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: All IHLs will offer selected AI-related courses for their alumni at a significant discount for a year, starting in the second half of this year.

key_points.point: He asked the Minister to clarify how he read the premise that Singaporeans are passive passengers into their speeches.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: I would urge the Minister to clarify how he has managed to read that basis into our speeches.

key_points.point: He said strong social safety nets and upskilling Singaporeans to embrace AI are not mutually exclusive.
key_points.speaker: Mr Low Wu Yang Andre
key_points.quote: we do not believe that strong social safety nets, and upskilling Singaporeans and urging them to embrace AI are mutually exclusive.

key_points.point: He said the answer is through real income improvement.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: I think the straight answer is through real income improvement.

key_points.point: He said SWDA will have key performance index outcomes tying the Enterprise Workforce Training Package and job redesign to real wages and career progression for workers.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: SWDA will have very clear key performance index outcomes, including tying the Enterprise Workforce Training Package, job redesign to specific skin in the game for both the businesses tapping on such grants, to improvement in real wages and career progression for the workers.

key_points.point: She said the direction is committed and should be discussed further with tripartite partners in the coming months.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: But yes, this is the direction that we are committed towards and we should discuss this further in the coming months.

key_points.point: He asked how companies, especially SMEs, are expected to determine when a 90-day notice for AI-driven role elimination should formally commence.
key_points.speaker: Mr Mark Lee (Nominated Member)
key_points.quote: could the Member clarify how companies, especially many of our SMEs, are expected to determine when this 90-day notice should formally commence?

key_points.point: He said he thinks they should err on the side of caution.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: I think we should err on the side of caution.

key_points.point: He described the four moves as no-regrets moves that are practical, grounded and effective.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: These are no-regrets moves – practical, grounded and effective.

key_points.point: He said he looks forward to measures unveiled through the Economic Strategy Review report.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: I look forward to the measures that will be unveiled through the Economic Strategy Review report.

key_points.point: He said NTUC supports the Government doing more to provide wage supplements if there are wider signs of labour market weaknesses.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: NTUC supports the Government doing more to provide wage supplements if indeed there are wider signs of labour market weaknesses.

key_points.point: He said if done too early or too broadly, employers may not have the right incentive to pay full wages.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: But should this be done too early or too broad a scale, then, employers may not have the right incentive to pay the full wages.

key_points.point: He said NTUC is not wedded to any particular form of support.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: NTUC is not wedded to any particular form.

key_points.point: He urged Members to support the Motion as it stands.
key_points.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng (Jalan Kayu)
key_points.quote: I urge Members of this House to support the Motion as it stands.

key_points.point: The Speaker put the question to the House after 24 speeches and over seven and a half hours.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: let me put the question to the House.

what_happens_next: The Speaker put the question to the House after 24 speeches and over seven and a half hours; the transcript does not record the result.
